module: Reusable camera rig for editor tools: pan state (pan, near-aerial view with north up) and orbit state with inertia, which produces a pose (pos, yaw, pitch, roll) for a script-driven camera (scriptedFree). Pure state and math module, with no engine coupling: the host tool reads the inputs, calls update() every frame and pushes the returned pose. Timed transitions between focuses remain the host's responsibility.
notes: Angles are in degrees; yaw 0 looks toward +Y, a positive pitch looks downward.
The returned position is a shared vec3 reused on every call: copy it to keep it.
The pan uses pitch 89.9 (not 90) and roll 0 to avoid degeneracy of the quaternion basis.

Constants: pan height 15 to 3000 m (default 220), zoom x0.86 per notch; orbit distance 6 to 2500 m (default 130), pitch -30 to 88, ground margin 2 m; mouse deltas > 250 px are rejected (hidden cursor recentering).

update.desc: Advances the interactive camera by one frame and returns the pose to push. In pan, a drag grabs the ground (with inertia); in orbit it rotates around the pivot (with inertia); the wheel zooms/dollies.

input.desc: { dragActive:boolean, dragDX:number, dragDY:number (screen pixels), wheel:number (notches), groundZAt:function(x,y[,heightAbove])->number|nil (ground altitude; average over the view if heightAbove), limitXY:function(x,y)->x,y (bounds the pan center) }

focusFootprint.desc: Switches to PAN mode centered on the origin of a footprint and returns its target top-down pose.

terrainH.desc: Ground altitude; if nil the last known one is kept.

height.desc: Camera height above the ground (clamped to 15-3000 m).

focusMassing.desc: Switches to ORBIT mode centered on the centroid of a building and returns its 3/4 target pose. The distance is radius*2.4 (clamped), otherwise 130 m.

recenter.desc: Moves the orbit PIVOT to `centroid` while keeping yaw/pitch/distance, and returns the pose that preserves the framing. Switches to orbit mode and cancels inertia.

centroid.desc: New pivot (each missing component keeps the old one).

settle.desc: Cancels any residual inertia (pan and orbit) and the drag state; to be called when a timed transition ends before handing control back to interaction.
